plan.trigger: Only if Nifty trades above R1 25995
plan.stop: Exit if Nifty falls below Pivot 25864

backtest.note: Technical rules only (no historical option-chain data)

playbook.headline: Leaning bullish. Watch R1 25,995: the call plan starts above it.

watch.name: Call-OI wall
watch.why: Most call writers sit here. It tends to cap rallies; a clean break can trigger a fast short-covering move.

watch.name: R2
watch.why: Call target and strong resistance. Book profits on calls here.

watch.name: R1
watch.why: Call trigger. A 15-minute close above this starts the CE plan.

watch.name: Last session high
watch.why: A break above often brings follow-through buying.

watch.name: Pivot
watch.why: Stop-loss line for both plans. Above it buyers control the day, below it sellers do.

watch.name: S1
watch.why: First support. Dips often find buyers here.

watch.name: Last session low
watch.why: A break below often brings follow-through selling.

watch.name: Max pain
watch.why: Where option buyers lose the most at expiry (01-Dec-2026). Nifty often drifts toward it close to expiry.

watch.name: S2
watch.why: Put target and strong support. Book profits on puts here.

watch.name: Put-OI wall
watch.why: Most put writers sit here. It tends to hold dips; a break can speed up a fall.

watch.name: 200-day average
watch.why: Long-term trend line that large funds watch.

watch.name: 50-day average
watch.why: Medium-term trend line. Closing above or below it shifts the bias.

scenarios.when: Nifty closes a 15-minute candle above R1 25,995
scenarios.then: Buy an ATM call. Target R2 26,106, exit if Nifty falls back below the pivot 25,864.

scenarios.when: Nifty closes a 15-minute candle below S1 25,754
scenarios.then: Buy an ATM put. Target S2 25,623, exit if Nifty climbs back above the pivot 25,864. This goes against today's bias, so trade smaller or skip it.

scenarios.when: Nifty stays between S1 25,754 and R1 25,995
scenarios.then: Don't buy options. Premiums lose value every hour in a sideways market.

scenarios.when: Nifty opens more than 129 points (0.5%) away from 25,884
scenarios.then: Wait 15 to 30 minutes. Big gaps often partly fill. Enter only if price holds beyond the first 15-minute high (gap up) or low (gap down).

alerts.title: Within 2% of the 52-week high of 26,373
alerts.detail: A move above 26,373 would be a major breakout.

note.headline: Charts lean bullish. Holding above 25,768 keeps buyers in charge.
note.summary: Rule-based read of the evidence: ADX 48.7: strong trend, buyers stronger; Morning star; Doji.

suggestions.title: Upside trigger above 25,944
suggestions.detail: A daily or 15-minute close above the resistance zone (2 touches) at 25,944 opens the next leg up. This fits the current lean.

suggestions.title: Downside trigger below 25,768
suggestions.detail: A close below the support zone (2 touches) at 25,768 opens room lower. This goes against the current lean, so trade smaller.

suggestions.title: Inside the range, stay patient
suggestions.detail: Between 25,768 and 25,944 there's no edge for option buyers; time decay works against you.

note.invalidation: A close beyond 25,944 or 25,768 against the lean.

structure.label: sideways
structure.detail: Mixed swings: lower high but higher low (narrowing).

candles.name: Morning star
candles.detail: A big down day, a small pause, then a strong up day: a classic bottoming sign.

candles.name: Doji
candles.detail: Open and close almost equal: indecision. After a rise, it can warn of a pause or top.
